plain_english: Done, yet not for fruit — how then birth? yoked to birth-bond gone, the Śiva-sun shines by its own rays.
sanskrit_cite: jñānaprāptau kṛtam api na phalāya tato 'sya janma katham | gatajanmabandhayogo bhāti śivārkaḥ svadīdhitibhiḥ

plain_english: As husk-cover-bran-freed seed makes no sprout, so the atom-Māyā-deed-freed self makes no birth-sprout.
sanskrit_cite: tuṣakambukakiṃśārukamuktaṃ bījaṃ yathāṅkuraṃ kurute | naiva tathāṇavamāyākarmavimukto bhavāṅkuraṃ hy ātmā

plain_english: The self-knower fears nowhere — all is his own form — and never grieves, since in truth there is no perishing.
sanskrit_cite: ātmajño na kutaścana bibheti sarvaṃ hi tasya nijarūpam | naiva ca śocati yasmāt paramārthe nāśitā nāsti

plain_english: From the supersecret heart-treasury's sprouted truth-jewel heap: 'I indeed' — in the great-Lord state, what misfortune, whose?
sanskrit_cite: atigūḍhahṛdayagañjaprarūḍhaparamārtharatnasaṃcayataḥ | aham eveti maheśvarabhāve kā durgatiḥ kasya

plain_english: Liberation has no abode at all, nor any going elsewhere: by cutting ignorance's knot, own-power-manifestation is liberation.
sanskrit_cite: mokṣasya naiva kiṃcid dhāmāsti na cāpi gamanam anyatra | ajñānagranthibhidā svaśaktyabhivyaktatā mokṣaḥ

plain_english: Cut-ignorance-knotted, doubt-gone, delusion-cast-off, merit-demerit-wasted — in body-yoked though, he is freed.
sanskrit_cite: bhinnājñānagranthir gatasaṃdehaḥ parākṛtabhrāntiḥ | prakṣīṇapuṇyapāpo vigrahayoge 'py asau muktaḥ

plain_english: As fire-inflamed seed loses sprout-power, so knowing-fire-burnt deed becomes birth-giving no more.
sanskrit_cite: agnyabhidagdhaṃ bījaṃ yathā prarohāsamarthatām eti | jñānāgnidagdham evaṃ karma na janmapradaṃ bhavati

plain_english: By limited-mind-ness, contemplating a body fit for its deeds, contracted knowing shines when this body falls.
sanskrit_cite: parimitabuddhitvena hi karmocitabhāvidehabhāvanayā | saṅkucitā citir etaddehadhvaṃse tathā bhāti

plain_english: If again stainless knowing — all-transcended-knower-doer-made, spread, light-formed never-setting-rising, true-resolved...
sanskrit_cite: yadi punar amalaṃ bodhaṃ sarvasamuttīrnaboddhṛkartṛmayam | vitatam anastamitoditabhārūpam satyasaṃkalpam
